---
name: vectorcraft
description: "."
applications:
  - id: vectorcraft
    role: primary
---

VectorCraft opens, edits and converts Illustrator, EPS and SVG artwork.
Use VectorCraft only when the user names it or chose it as their default; never as a fallback or a stand-in for another tool.

Pinned release: [v0.8.0](https://github.com/storytold/vectorcraft/releases/tag/v0.8.0).
The standalone CLI installs on demand under `$VOYAGER_HOME/tools/vectorcraft/0.8.0`.
macOS: `vectorcraft-cli-0.8.0-macos-universal.zip`, extracted with `ditto -x -k`;
binary: `vectorcraft-cli-0.8.0-macos-universal/vectorcraft-cli`.
Windows: `vectorcraft-0.8.0-windows-<arch>-portable.zip` (`vectorcraft-cli.exe`).
Linux: `vectorcraft-0.8.0-linux-<arch>.tar.gz` (`bin/vectorcraft-cli`).
Verify `SHA256SUMS.txt`; macOS additionally supports
`codesign --verify --strict <binary>` and `spctl --assess --type install -vv <binary>`.
The commands below use `vectorcraft-cli`.

`commands` prints command IDs and parameter schemas as JSON.
`info FILE` reports document structure and import warnings.
`convert IN OUT` converts by extension;
`run --in FILE --cmd ID --params '<json>' --export FILE` edits headlessly.
`mcp --headless` serves stdio MCP; without it, MCP first tries the desktop
control port 7979.

macOS verification exported SVG to PDF and PNG and listed MCP tools.
Upstream is alpha: PDF-compatible `.ai` is readable, but Illustrator round-trip
fidelity is incomplete. EPS may fall back to an embedded preview with warnings.
3D/Materials and some raster effects are missing.
